title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31429v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained diffusion/flow-based video generators assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, yet physical consistency is history-dependent: preceding events constrain what can physically occur later. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework that uses MLLMs to formulate history-conditioned physical expectations and tracks their agreement with observed video windows through temporal video--language alignment, rather than relying on direct plausibility judgments or task-specific probes. On IntPhys2, PhysTrace achieves 67.2% possible--impossible discrimination accuracy, outperforming the evaluated direct MLLM baselines. We further introduce reference-guided masked denoising for controlled reconstruction from mixed possible--impossible video latents. To

translated_title: PhysTrace：视频生成模型中物理一致性的可解释时序评估
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型日益依赖预训练的基于扩散/流模型的视频生成器，并假设其能够捕捉物理动态，以用于预测、规划和动作生成。现有评估方法要么评估合理性、要么探测模型内部表示、要么衡量预测的意外程度，然而物理一致性是依赖于历史的：先前发生的事件约束了之后物理上可能发生的内容。我们提出了PhysTrace，这是一个无需训练的框架，它利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）构建以历史为条件的物理预期，并通过时序视频-语言对齐来追踪这些预期与观测到的视频片段之间的一致性，而不是依赖直接的合理性判断或任务特定的探针。在IntPhys2基准上，PhysTrace实现了67.2%的“可能-不可能”判别准确率，优于所评估的直接MLLM基线方法。我们进一步引入了参考引导的掩码去噪方法，用于从混合的可能与不可能视频潜变量中进行受控重建。
tldr: PhysTrace是一个无需训练的可解释评估框架，它利用多模态大语言模型构建基于历史事件的物理预期，并通过时序视频-语言对齐追踪预期与视频内容的一致性，从而实现对视频生成模型物理一致性的时序评估，在IntPhys2上达到67.2%的判别准确率。
en_tdlr: PhysTrace is a training-free, interpretable framework that uses MLLMs to formulate history-conditioned physical expectations and tracks their agreement with observed video via temporal video-language alignment, achieving 67.2% possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2 and enabling temporal evaluation of physical consistency in video generative models.
